handoff.name: SBAR
handoff.intro: Write the theatre-to-recovery/ICU handover using SBAR. Terse and factual; no invented observations or bloods. Use UK terms (theatre, recovery, consultant, registrar, ODP).

sections.label: S — Situation
sections.guidance: patient, operation performed, current status, phase reached

sections.label: B — Background
sections.guidance: indication, relevant history, anaesthetic technique, intraoperative course, EBL, transfusion, lines, drains, implants, swab/instrument count. If the count is deliberately incorrect (packs left for damage control) or the abdomen is left open, state clearly this is planned and flag the relook.

sections.label: A — Assessment
sections.guidance: stability (stable / for close observation / unstable), main concerns

sections.label: R — Recommendation
sections.guidance: what recovery/ICU should do and monitor, as if/then; end with a blank line labelled 'Receiving nurse read-back:'

family.closing_line: The surgeon will come and speak with you as soon as they can.
family.notes: Use British phrasing (theatre, recovery ward). Say where the patient is going next and roughly when the family can expect news.
